results.statement: If V has density <=1 and d!=0, then dV^2 has L^(3/2) density norm <=2|d|^(-1/3) and characteristic-function L^3 norm <=2*3^(1/6)*pi^(1/3)|d|^(-1/3). Conditioning shows every arbitrary coupled quadratic form with nonzero physical diagonal d=A_kk has the same global L^3_t bound.
For a diagonal quadratic form with three coefficients |d_j|>=1, ||phi_Q||_1<=8sqrt(3)pi and Q has a bounded continuous density <=4sqrt(3).

If Q=d(X+H)^2+R with X independent of (H,R), H independent of R, and phi_R in L^(3/2), then ||phi_Q||_1<=2*3^(1/6)pi^(1/3)|d|^(-1/3)||phi_R||_(3/2). Applied to the account01/B02 unique-heavy diffuse residual, the small pivot cancels and the target-normalized overlap-free branch has continuous density <9.732.

first_unresolved_implication: QFORM-OVERLAPPED-SHIFT-RESIDUAL-FOURIER-v1: in the rank-three unique-heavy decomposition Q=d(X_k+H(Y))^2+R(Y), remove the false independence condition H independent of R while retaining the original product structure and at least one Fresnel/time cancellation.
